1. Our Service

CardScanFox is a mobile app designed to help users scan, search, identify, organize, and track trading cards and sports cards.

The app may provide features including:

  • Card scanning and identification

  • Card information lookup

  • Price and value reference

  • Collection tracking

  • Portfolio management

  • Wishlist or saved card features

  • Raw and graded card information when available

  • Support for selected TCG and sports card categories

CardScanFox currently supports or may support categories including Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Disney Lorcana, Digimon, Star Wars: Unlimited, Flesh and Blood, basketball cards, baseball cards, and football cards.

Feature availability depends on platform and app version. We may update or change the Service subject to applicable notice requirements, paid entitlements, and mandatory consumer rights.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 13 years old to use CardScanFox. If you are under the age of majority in your country or region, you may use CardScanFox only with permission from a parent or legal guardian.

By using CardScanFox, you confirm that you are legally able to agree to these Terms and that your use of the Service complies with applicable laws.

3. Accounts and Platform Separation

Android offers guest access, email-and-password registration, and Google sign-in. iOS offers the supported sign-in methods shown in the iOS app. You are responsible for supplying accurate account information and protecting your credentials and device. Contact support if you suspect unauthorized access.

Android and iOS use separate platform accounts and personal data spaces, even where databases or authentication infrastructure are shared. Using the same email address or sign-in provider on both platforms does not merge or synchronize collections, Wishlist, folders, scan records, preferences, or collection-value records. Public card catalog and reference prices may be shared.

Apple purchase rights apply to iOS. Free Android access does not require an Apple subscription and does not grant an iOS subscription. Guest access may involve locally stored or server-side records and technical identifiers as described in the Privacy Policy.

4. Account and Data Deletion

You can initiate deletion through Delete Account in the app's account settings, visit our account deletion page, or email support@tcgcard.fun. Specify the platform, Android or iOS, and the relevant account. If the page opens an email draft, you must send it. You do not need to reinstall the app to request deletion. We may verify your identity; never send your password or verification codes.

Once a verified deletion is executed, we immediately delete the selected platform account and its associated information on our own servers, including collections, Wishlist, folders, saved card details, uploaded scan images and records, and preferences. We do not retain those deleted records on our servers for account recovery. Support requests may require review and verification before execution.

Deletion ends access through that platform account's sessions and is permanent. You must register again to use an account on that platform. Reusing the same email address or Google sign-in does not restore deleted data. The other platform's separate account and records remain unaffected. A shared authentication record needed by the other active platform does not reactivate the deleted account.

The immediate deletion of our server records does not imply simultaneous deletion of third-party analytics, attribution, diagnostic, or Apple transaction records. Their treatment and available privacy requests are explained in the Privacy Policy.

Deleting the app or your CardScanFox account does not cancel an Apple subscription or delete your Apple or Google account. Manage Apple subscriptions in your Apple account settings. Subscription cancellation is not required before submitting an account-deletion request. Uninstalling alone does not delete a server account. Contact support for help deleting guest data or both platform accounts.

5. Card Scanning

Scanning uses your camera or images you select from your photo library. The images are uploaded to our server for recognition. Uploaded images and associated scan records are retained until deletion of the relevant platform account, unless removed earlier through an available deletion feature. We do not use your uploaded images or scan records for model training.

Recognition can be affected by lighting, image quality, card condition, language, finish, edition, or catalog coverage. Review the suggested match before saving a card or relying on its information. Card recognition is not a guarantee of authenticity or a professional grading service.

The current Android release supports a maximum of 10 cards in a scan batch. When the pending batch reaches that limit, you must save cards to your collection or delete pending results before continuing. The iOS free-scan allowance does not impose a lifetime 10-scan allowance on Android.

Only upload content that you are entitled to use. Do not upload unlawful content or images that infringe another person's privacy or intellectual-property rights.

Website AI pregrading

AI pregrading estimates visible card condition from your photos. It is separate from professional authentication and certified grading by PSA, BGS or CGC. A photo estimate is not a trading guarantee or a promise of a professional grade. The cost calculator uses the values and costs you enter; it does not generate a market price or a guaranteed return.

6. Card Data, Prices, and Value Information

CardScanFox may display card information, market prices, estimated values, historical data, grading-related information, collection totals, or other reference data.

You understand and agree that:

  • Card data and price information may be incomplete, delayed, unavailable, inaccurate, or based on third-party sources.

  • Price and value information is provided for general informational purposes only.

  • CardScanFox does not provide financial, investment, appraisal, grading, tax, legal, or professional advice.

  • Displayed values do not guarantee that a card can be bought or sold at that price.

  • Actual market prices may vary based on condition, grading, authenticity, demand, platform fees, shipping, taxes, buyer behavior, seller behavior, and other factors.

  • You are responsible for independently verifying any information before buying, selling, grading, trading, insuring, or valuing any card.

We are not responsible for losses, decisions, transactions, missed opportunities, or disputes arising from your reliance on card data, scan results, price estimates, or value information shown in the app.

7. Collection Records

CardScanFox may allow you to save cards, edit collection details, add purchase prices, set quantities, choose finishes, record grading information, organize cards, and track collection value.

You are responsible for the accuracy of information you manually enter or edit. We do not guarantee that your collection value, portfolio value, profit/loss calculation, or related analytics will always be complete or accurate.

You should keep your own backup of important records where necessary.

Android

People using the original free Android release keep its free access. Where an Android subscription is offered, Google Play displays the local price, billing period, eligible trial and renewal terms before you confirm. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. iOS

On iOS, CardScanFox may offer paid subscriptions, free trials, premium features, or other in-app purchases through Apple’s in-app purchase system.

If you purchase a subscription:

  • Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.

  • Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

  • Your account may be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.

  • You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.

  • Deleting the app or deleting your CardScanFox account does not automatically cancel your subscription.

  • Any unused portion of a free trial may be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

  • Prices, subscription periods, available features, and free trial offers may vary by country, region, user, promotional campaign, or App Store settings.

All billing, refunds, cancellations, and payment issues for App Store purchases are handled by Apple under Apple’s policies. We cannot directly cancel, refund, or modify App Store transactions unless Apple provides us with the ability to do so.

Premium features may change over time. We may add, remove, modify, or limit premium features, provided that we do not materially reduce the core functionality of an active paid subscription without appropriate notice where required by law.

A non-renewing one-time purchase, when offered, is charged once and does not automatically renew. Its scope is the entitlement described at purchase. A lifetime purchase does not mean ownership of the Service or a guarantee that the Service will operate indefinitely. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

Restore Purchases on iOS uses eligible purchase information supplied by Apple. Restoring a purchase does not restore deleted collections or other deleted account records, and it does not transfer Apple entitlements to Android.

▸Development Tools Not Included in the Application

MMDetection, MMCV, MMEngine, MMDeploy, ONNX, and OpenCV were used in model training, conversion, validation, or as preprocessing references. Their libraries are not included in the current mobile application. In particular, the mobile image-resize implementation matches OpenCV's half-pixel bilinear sampling behavior but does not include OpenCV.
